GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 767.3 (8 Dec 45) CCS
(SCAPIN - 409)
8 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Japanese Cable Ship Tsurishima.
1. The Japanese Cable ship TSURISHIMA was due to arrive at Yokohama on 6 December 1945.
2. This ship will be used to repair submarine cables as directed by this headquarters.
3. The KURE-MATSUYAMA submarine cable is assigned first priority for repair, work will be initiated at the earliest practicable date.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
